title: github-actions-node24-and-cache-warning-cleanup
reason: The successful master CI run 29374274047 reported Node.js 20 action-runtime deprecation annotations and a governance Maven cache path that is never populated; update pinned actions to Node 24-compatible releases and remove only the unused governance Maven cache without weakening any gate.
oldRule: The workflow pinned actions/checkout v4.2.2, actions/setup-node v4.4.0, and actions/setup-java v4.7.1 builds that run on the deprecated Node.js 20 action runtime. The governance job also enabled setup-java Maven caching even though it never invokes Maven, so the cache path was never created.
newRule: Pin checkout v5.0.1, setup-node v5.0.0, and setup-java v5.5.0 by their immutable release SHAs. The governance job retains JDK 17 but does not request Maven caching because it never populates the Maven repository; the backend-tests job retains setup-java and cache: maven.

evidence.localVerification: Focused workflow regression 43/43; complete repository gate 481/481; CI declaration and immutable-action lint pass.

checklist: Explain old rule and new rule.
List sample files proving the project base needs this rule.
Run npm run check after the rule proposal is accepted.
